# Rough Notebook

> Free keyboard-first digital rough notebook for DSA, algorithms, and coding interview practice: freeform notes, arrays, matrices, and manual tracing on a warm paper canvas.

## Product
- Name: Rough Notebook
- Tagline: Think it. Trace it. Solve it.
- Author: Shambhoo Narwaria
- Stack: Svelte 5, TypeScript, Vite, Cloudflare Workers

## Features
- Keyboard-first navigation (⌘/ or Ctrl+/ to insert, Tab to navigate cells)
- Smart auto-create from pasted testcase arrays & matrices
- Frictionless freehand pen drawing layer with per-stroke undo
- Warm paper canvas aesthetic with subtle dot grid
